states.name: Flittle
states.title: Flittle
states.description: The flowers of Flittles contain a pollen that aids sleep. For this reason they are highly sought after by apothecaries, who use honey to distract the Flittle while they harvest the pollen.

states.name: Flortuga
states.title: Flortuga
states.description: Flortuga are popular companion monsters due to their charming appearance and their profound loyalty. If a Flortuga develops a fondness for someone, they will present them with a flower from their backs. A flower willingly given by a Flortuga will never wilt.
